The subscription books for the new notes were opened December 4 and were closed at the close of business on December 7. The notes, designated Series B-1955, are dated December 15. Exchanges of the bonds will be made par for par on December 15, and exchanges of the certificates, Series A-1951, are to be made at par with an adjustment of interest on January 1.
